annotation.title_clean: The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
annotation.title_en: The General-Purpose AI Code of Practice
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (AI Office)
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page describing the voluntary General-Purpose AI Code of Practice (published 10 July 2025), which helps GPAI model providers demonstrate compliance with AI Act Articles 53 and 55 through chapters on Transparency, Copyright, and Safety and Security, and lists signatories and the Signatory Taskforce.
key_provisions_or_claims: Code is a voluntary tool confirmed by the Commission and AI Board as adequate for demonstrating AI Act compliance.
Three chapters: Transparency, Copyright, Safety and Security.
Transparency and Copyright chapters address Article 53 obligations for all GPAI providers.
Safety and Security chapter applies to providers of systemic-risk models under Article 55.
Signatories gain reduced administrative burden and more legal certainty; a Signatory Taskforce chaired by the AI Office coordinates application.
